title: AdaptFuse: Training-Free Sequential Preference Inference via Externalized Bayesian Computation
abstract: arXiv:2604.03925v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to accumulate evidence across multiple rounds of user interactions, failing to update their beliefs in a manner consistent with Bayesian inference. Existing solutions require fine-tuning on sensitive user interaction data, limiting their applicability in privacy-conscious settings. We propose \textsc{AdaptFuse}, a training-free framework that externalizes probabilistic computation entirely from the LLM, where a symbolic module maintains a Bayesian posterior over a discrete hypothesis set, while a frozen LLM contributes semantic reasoning via multi-sample Dirichlet aggregation. The two signals are combined through entropy-adaptive fusion, which automatically weights each source by its predictive confidence, shifting reliance from the LLM to the symbolic posterior as evidence accumulates. translated_title: AdaptFuse：通过外置化贝叶斯计算实现无需训练的序列偏好推断
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）难以在多轮用户交互中积累证据，无法以符合贝叶斯推断的方式更新其信念。现有解决方案需要在敏感的用户交互数据上进行微调，这限制了其在注重隐私场景中的适用性。我们提出了AdaptFuse，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将概率计算完全从LLM中外置化：一个符号模块在离散假设集合上维护贝叶斯后验分布，而冻结的LLM则通过多样本Dirichlet聚合贡献语义推理。两种信号通过熵自适应融合机制进行结合，该机制根据各来源的预测置信度自动分配权重，并随着证据的积累，将依赖重心从LLM逐渐转移到符号后验上。我们在三个领域进行了评估：航班推荐、酒店推荐和网购；在Gemma 2 9B上，（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了无需训练的AdaptFuse框架，将贝叶斯后验计算外置于符号模块，并与冻结LLM的语义推理通过熵自适应融合相结合，从而在保护隐私的前提下实现多轮交互中用户偏好的序列化累积推断。
en_tdlr: AdaptFuse is a training-free framework that externalizes Bayesian posterior computation to a symbolic module and fuses it with a frozen LLM's semantic reasoning via entropy-adaptive weighting, enabling privacy-preserving sequential user preference inference across multi-turn interactions.
